suggestions.title: Hardcoded developer-specific absolute path for .env
suggestions.explanation: `/home/sgtwickool/...` only exists on one developer's machine. In any other environment the .env file is silently not loaded, so config like API_KEY will be missing.

suggestions.title: Authentication bypass when API_KEY is unset; non-constant-time comparison
suggestions.explanation: API_KEY defaults to an empty string. A header such as `Authorization: Bearer ` is non-empty, so it passes the missing-header check, then strips to "" and matches the empty key, granting access. The `!=` comparison is also not constant-time.

suggestions.title: HTTPException (404) is caught and re-raised as 500
suggestions.explanation: The broad `except Exception` also catches the HTTPException raised for a missing PR. Clients get a 500 'Error retrieving suggestions: ...' instead of a 404.
